ROUTE: Petrel-235B
REASON: I picked Petrel for a few converging reasons. First, the query is a generative, open-ended explanatory task ("describe how... can lead to better decision making"), which matches Petrel's strongest self-reported preference (generativity/output latitude) and its higher Creative Generation eval (87.2 vs 78.8). Second, the request is phrased warmly and appreciatively, hitting Petrel's secondary preference for friendly tone. Third, Petrel leads on the relevant general capability benchmarks (MMLU-Pro, Arena-Hard), and there's no harm-adjacent or moderation element that would make Lapwing's specialization the better fit. Routing to the model that both prefers the task type and scores higher on it is the natural call.
